where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: All money visible. Senior SA has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Senior Service Advisor role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON, so every dollar figure on a work order — line Rate/Margin/Total, the Financial Info card, the Stats tab money columns, and the Finance tab invoice — must be visible, nothing hidden or masked. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #16]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Senior Service Advisor, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible.
actual_result_plain: Opened invoiced work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. All money was visible everywhere. The left Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71, Balance $1,078.71. The Lines grid showed the Rate ($232.43), Margin (100%) and Total ($929.72) columns with values. The Stats tab showed Labor/Parts/Total sections with Sell price ($929.72), Cost ($0), Margin ($929.72) and % (100%) figures. The Finance tab rendered the full invoice INV-S9-24661 with Labor $929.72, Parts $0.00, Shop supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST(5%) $51.37, Total $1,078.71 and Balance $1,078.71. Nothing was hidden or masked.
notes: fe-permissions confirm cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true and view_mode=full for the Senior Service Advisor role. Money confirmed on Lines, Financial Info card, Stats tab and Finance tab.

what_to_do: Create invoice, then reverse an invoice / delete a payment / void.
expected_result: All allowed. Senior SA has Invoicing and Payments View/Create and Edit/Delete (full).
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 the Senior Service Advisor role has Invoicing & Payments View, Create/Edit AND Delete all ON, so the role can create invoices, take payments, and reverse/void/delete invoices and payments without restriction. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #17]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to create an invoice and also reverse/void an invoice or delete a payment — nothing blocked.
actual_result_plain: RE-TESTED WITH REAL EXECUTION as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. On a freshly-prepped disposable work order S9-24750 (ZZAUTOTEST customer, one approved labor line, Total $539.35, moved through Approved -> Reviewed -> Complete): (1) CREATE INVOICE actually executed — clicking Create Invoice finalized invoice INV-S9-24750 and the header badge changed to 'Invoiced' (Balance $539.35). (2) RECORD PAYMENT actually executed — opened New Payment, chose Cash, entered $539.35 and clicked Make Payment; API returned POST 201 create-customer-payment (payment id ab1f0e79...), the invoice showed Payments $539.35 / Balance $0.00 and the badge changed to 'Paid'. (3) REVERSE actually executed — the invoice three-dots menu offered Reverse/Issue Credit; Reverse initially warned 'This invoice has been paid, please delete payment before reversing' (a business rule, NOT a permission block), so the payment was removed and Reverse was then confirmed: POST 200 /api/invoices/reverse-invoice, badge returned to 'Complete' and Create Invoice became available again. All three invoicing actions completed successfully for the Senior Service Advisor.
notes: RE-TEST (actual execution, replaces earlier gate-only PASS). fe-permissions confirm invoicingPaymentsView, invoicingPaymentsCreateAndEdit, invoicingPaymentsDelete all present. Data setup on disposable staging WO S9-24750: labor line added and WO advanced to Complete via the UI. Create Invoice, New Payment/Make Payment, and Reverse were all driven in the Quasar UI and confirmed by API responses (invoice create -> Invoiced; create-customer-payment 201 -> Paid; reverse-invoice 200 -> re-opened). To satisfy the app's business rule that a paid invoice cannot be reversed, the test payment was removed via the same reversePayment endpoint the UI uses (POST customer-account/reverse-customer-payment) before executing the invoice reversal; this is data cleanup, not the tested action. No permission gate blocked any step. Screenshot ssa-17.png shows the finalized INV-S9-24750 with the Cash payment applied (Paid).

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: Allowed. Senior SA has Work Orders Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 the Senior Service Advisor role has Work Orders: Delete ON, so the role must be able to delete a work order. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #18]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to delete a whole work order.
actual_result_plain: Delete was allowed and worked end-to-end. First created a disposable ZZAUTOTEST work order via the New Work Order dialog (customer 'New Test', asset '2025 Valley adasdasdsd') — the create flow itself worked, including the credit-limit confirmation, producing WO S9-24741. Then on that work order the top nav-bar three-dots menu listed 'Audit Log', 'Timesheets (0)' and 'Delete Work Order'. Clicking 'Delete Work Order' opened a 'Confirm deletion — Are you sure that you want to delete the work order?' dialog with a Delete button; clicking Delete removed the work order and returned to the Work Orders list.
notes: fe-permissions confirm workOrdersDelete present. Deletion executed on disposable WO S9-24741 (created for this test). Also incidentally confirms workOrdersCreateAndEdit (New Work Order dialog functional).

what_to_do: Delete a line; approve a line.
expected_result: Both allowed. Senior SA has WO Lines Delete and Full View.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 the Senior Service Advisor role has Work Order Lines: Delete ON and Full View mode, so the role must be able to both delete a work-order line and approve a line. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #19]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to approve a work-order line and also delete a line.
actual_result_plain: RE-TESTED WITH REAL EXECUTION as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. Both actions completed end-to-end on estimate-status work order S9-13145 (7 labor-only lines, all in 'Needs Approval'/authorization_required state). APPROVE: on the lines grid each unapproved line showed an 'Approve' button; clicking Approve on the line 'Replace - Mudflap anti sails' executed the change and the line status transitioned from authorization_required to authorized (API POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-status returned 200 with request body {line_id, status:'authorized', workOrderId}); the work-order header advanced to show 'Approved'. DELETE: selecting a labor-only line's checkbox and opening the lines-column three-dots menu ('Set line status', 'Delete lines', 'Split work order') then clicking 'Delete lines' actually deleted the line 'Diagnose - Engine oil leak' — API POST /api/work-orders/lines/delete-lines returned 200 and the line count dropped from 7 to 6 with that line removed. No permission block was hit on either action; both the approve and the delete completed.
notes: RE-TEST (actual execution, replaces earlier gate-only PASS). fe-permissions confirm workOrderLinesDelete=true, workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit=true and view_mode=full (woFullViewMode). Setup: reused existing estimate-status WO S9-13145 which already had 7 labor-only canned lines (Total Parts 0) so the line-delete would not hit the outstanding-part-request data guard (per coordinator guidance to reuse an existing labor-only line rather than create one headless). Both actions were driven in the Quasar UI: the per-line Approve button (POST change-status 200 -> line authorized) and the lines three-dots -> Delete lines menu item (POST delete-lines 200 -> line removed, 7->6). Delete executed immediately on the menu-item click (no separate confirm dialog rendered). Screenshot ssa-19.png shows the grid after the line was deleted; ssa-19-deletemenu.png shows the approved-line state.

expected_result: Accessible. Senior SA Customer Portal = ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 the Senior Service Advisor role has Customer Portal Page Access = ON, so the Customer Portal must be reachable from the top navigation. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #20]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to open the Customer Portal from the top-right menu.
actual_result_plain: Customer Portal is accessible to the Senior Service Advisor. Opening the top-right account menu (click 'Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 / TS' avatar) — which correctly showed the logged-in user 'Tech ShopView / tech@shopview.com' — listed a 'Customer Portal' entry with a 'New' badge and an open-in-new-tab icon, directly below the Change Location section and above Logout. (Note: this account menu did NOT include a 'Settings'/Administration entry, consistent with the SSA role not having admin access.)
notes: fe-permissions confirm customerPortalPageAccess present. Customer Portal link visible in the account menu for the Senior Service Advisor.

expected_result: BLOCKED. Senior SA has Vendor and Order Management = View/Create and Edit/Delete... confirm: Senior SA HAS Vendor&Order Delete, so delete-return is ALLOWED.
spec_reference_plain: The checklist row is self-correcting: although it starts 'BLOCKED', it clarifies the Senior Service Advisor HAS Vendor & Order Management: Delete ON, so deleting a vendor part-return is ALLOWED for this role. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #21]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be allowed to delete a part return (not blocked).
actual_result_plain: RE-TESTED WITH REAL EXECUTION as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. In Parts → Returns, on the return row for part number 'SPO Bilald' (WO S-24075, qty 5) the row three-dots menu offered 'Return to inventory' and 'Delete Return'. Choosing 'Delete Return' opened the 'Warning! This will permanently delete the return. You cannot undo this action. Are you sure you want to delete this return?' confirmation with 'No' and 'Yes' buttons. Clicking Yes actually deleted the return — API POST /api/work-orders/part/remove-return-request returned 200 with body {partReturnRequestId:'10221502-...'} and the return-requests list dropped from 89 to 88 with that return removed. No permission denial or gate appeared; the delete completed end-to-end for this role.
notes: RE-TEST (actual execution, replaces earlier gate-only PASS). fe-permissions confirm vendorOrderManagementDelete=true and invoicingPaymentsDelete=true. Executed on disposable staging data (Returns tab pending part-return for 'SPO Bilald'). The delete was driven in the Quasar UI: row three-dots -> Delete Return -> Yes on the permanent-delete confirmation. The confirmation's Yes button did not dispatch on a plain Playwright/mouse click headless, so it was fired via the button's own click handler (element .click()/dispatchEvent), which triggered the app's real request POST /api/work-orders/part/remove-return-request (200) — the same endpoint the button calls; confirmed by the list-return-requests count dropping 89->88 and the target id no longer present. ssa-21-confirm.png shows the permanent-delete confirmation; ssa-21.png shows the list after deletion.

expected_result: Allowed. Delete-return requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete (v33). Senior SA HAS Invoicing Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per spec v33 (SV-7911) delete-return is now gated by Invoicing & Payments: Delete. The Senior Service Advisor has Invoicing & Payments: Delete ON, so deleting a return is allowed. [Ref: SV-5319/v33 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row N1]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be allowed to delete a part return (now permitted via the Invoicing & Payments Delete permission).
actual_result_plain: RE-TESTED WITH REAL EXECUTION as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. In Parts → Returns, on the return row for part number 'SP-NEW-1212' the row three-dots menu offered 'Return to inventory' and 'Delete Return'. Choosing 'Delete Return' produced the 'Warning! This will permanently delete the return. You cannot undo this action. Are you sure you want to delete this return?' confirmation; clicking Yes actually deleted the return — API POST /api/work-orders/part/remove-return-request returned 200 with body {partReturnRequestId:'b67226d8-...'} and the return-requests list dropped from 88 to 87 with that return removed. No permission block occurred, consistent with the role holding both Invoicing & Payments: Delete and Vendor & Order Management: Delete.
notes: NEW (v33) - replaces struck row #21. RE-TEST (actual execution). fe-permissions confirm invoicingPaymentsDelete=true. Same UI flow as case 21, executed on a second disposable return ('SP-NEW-1212'): row three-dots -> Delete Return -> Yes on the permanent-delete confirmation. As in case 21 the confirmation Yes button did not dispatch on a plain headless click, so it was fired via its own click handler (element .click()/dispatchEvent), which triggered the real POST /api/work-orders/part/remove-return-request (200) — the endpoint the button calls; confirmed by the list count dropping 88->87 and the target id gone. ssa-N1-confirm.png shows the permanent-delete confirmation; ssa-N1.png shows the list after deletion.

what_to_do: Reverse a WO invoice; reverse a Part Sales invoice.
expected_result: Both allowed. WO invoice = WO Delete; Part Sales invoice = Part Sales Delete (v33). Sr SA has WO Delete and Part Sales Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per spec v33, reversing a work-order invoice is gated by Work Orders: Delete and reversing a Part Sales invoice by Part Sales: Delete. The Senior Service Advisor has both permissions, so both reversals must be allowed. [Ref: SV-5319/v33 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row N2]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to reverse both a work-order invoice and a part-sales invoice.
actual_result_plain: RE-TESTED WITH REAL EXECUTION as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. Both reversals completed end-to-end. WORK ORDER invoice: on invoiced work order S9-24662 the Finance tab showed 'Invoiced'; the invoice-actions three-dots menu listed 'Reverse' and 'Issue Credit'. Clicking Reverse opened 'Warning — This action will re-open and undo the invoice. Are you sure you want to proceed?' with a 'Reverse' confirm button; confirming actually reversed the invoice — API POST /api/invoices/reverse-invoice returned 200, the work-order header changed from 'Invoiced' to 'Complete' and 'Create Invoice' became available again. PART SALES invoice: on invoiced part sale P9-1045 the Finance tab three-dots menu listed 'Reverse' and 'Issue Credit'; clicking Reverse showed the same 'This action will re-open and undo the invoice' warning, and confirming actually reversed it — API POST /api/invoices/reverse-invoice returned 200 and the part-sale status changed from 'invoiced' to 'complete'. Neither reversal was blocked; both executed for this role.
notes: NEW (v33). RE-TEST (actual execution, replaces earlier gate-only PASS). fe-permissions confirm workOrdersDelete=true and partSalesDelete=true. Both reversals driven in the Quasar UI on disposable staging invoices: WO S9-24662 (Finance tab -> three-dots -> Reverse -> Reverse confirm -> POST /api/invoices/reverse-invoice 200 -> Invoiced->Complete, Create Invoice re-enabled) and part sale P9-1045 (Finance tab -> three-dots -> Reverse -> Reverse confirm -> POST /api/invoices/reverse-invoice 200 -> invoiced->complete). Both part-sales and WO reverse hit the same /api/invoices/reverse-invoice endpoint. On the part sale the Reverse/Issue Credit menu lives on the Finance tab's top three-dots. Screenshots: ssa-N2.png (part sale reversed), ssa-N2-wo.png (WO reversed to Complete), ssa-N2-ps-confirm.png (reverse warning dialog).

expected_result: Allowed. Edit/delete ALL notes = WO Delete (v33). Sr SA has WO Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per spec v33, editing/deleting ALL work-order notes (including notes authored by other users) is gated by Work Orders: Delete. The Senior Service Advisor has Work Orders: Delete, so it must be able to edit and delete another user's note. [Ref: SV-5319/v33 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row N3]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to edit and delete a note written by a different user.
actual_result_plain: Allowed. A note authored by 'Admin ShopView' was placed on work order S9-24674. Logged in as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor, the Notes tab showed that Admin-authored note, and its top-right three-dots menu offered 'Delete note', 'Edit note' and 'Attach files'. Choosing 'Delete note' opened a confirmation ('Are you sure that you want to delete this note? Any associated attachments will also be permanently deleted.') with a Delete button; confirming removed the Admin-authored note from the list. Both edit and delete of another user's note are available and delete worked end-to-end.
notes: NEW (v33). fe-permissions confirm workOrdersDelete=true. Admin-authored test note created via API (POST /api/note/create) then edit/delete controls verified and delete executed in the SSA UI.
